worldcombat.skill.healblock.summary: Clamp a ward on the target: until it releases, the target cannot recover HP through moves, Abilities or held items, and any rise is pressed back to where it was.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.use.0: Lock down an opponent that stalls with recovery
worldcombat.skill.healblock.use.2: Cut off healing before a burst
Apply the ward within %2$s blocks; the target's HP recovery is sealed for %1$s s, then releases on its own.
The ward tightens around the target; any rise above the health floor is pressed back.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.hold.on: Long ward on: seal duration x1.35 and cooldown +16 ticks, holding one target down longer.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.hold.off: Long ward off: seal duration x0.75 and cooldown -10 ticks, shorter but more frequent.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.growth.0: At level %1$s the seal duration rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.growth.1: At level %1$s the seal duration rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.preference.h: On = long ward: duration x1.35 and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = quick ward: duration x0.75 and cooldown -10 ticks. Duration trades against cast frequency.
worldcombat.skill.healblock.preference.a: The companion only wards a threat within this distance; smaller means only at close range, larger means sealing recovery from farther away.
On: only prioritise warding a target above half health, saving the seal for opponents that might sustain. Off: every enemy is warded alike.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to ward a target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
